description.en: Hammer Zombie rotates when a projectile hits him while walking.
description.zh: 捶鼓僵尸被直射子弹击中时开始旋转。

chat.en: Every joint between his bones can rotate with ease — given by years of hammer-swinging practice.
chat.zh: 他身上的所有关节都能自由旋转，这可是常年用巧劲连续捶鼓积累出来的。

text.en: rotates and returns projectiles that are shot straightly ahead
text.zh: 旋转并反弹直射过来的子弹
